tasks.title: Use avatar-stack spacing for Topic Tab icons
tasks.objective: Make the Topic Tab icon rail read as one dense work-surface group while preserving individual Tab interaction.
tasks.outcome: Adjacent Tab chips overlap by the shared avatar-stack rhythm, and hovered/focused chips rise above neighbors without changing Tab order.
acceptance: The Tab rail uses the shared small overlap rhythm instead of a positive gap, reducing the total footprint while retaining every Tab slot.
Each Tab chip has an explicit stacking order from its Tab index; hover/focus raises the targeted chip so its icon and selected state remain readable.
Keyboard focus order, hover inspector selection, active Tab state and Topic opening behavior remain unchanged.
Removing the overlap or stacking contract makes the focused test/source guard red, and the TopicPresence production caller remains present.

verification.proves: Topic Tab topology and overlap contract.
Changed renderer code and styles compile cleanly.
The reusable topology remains connected from the Topic product surface.
